  - Enacts the **Further Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024**.
  - Purpose stated: making further consolidated appropriations for the **fiscal year ending September 30, 2024**, and for other purposes.
  - Act identified as **Public Law 118-47**, **H.R. 2882**, enacted **March 23, 2024**.

- **Sec. 1 — Short title**
  - Establishes citation: **“Further Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024.”**
  - No appropriation amount; no amendment to existing law stated.

- **Sec. 2 — Table of contents**
  - Sets organizational structure of the Act.
  - Lists general sections:
    - Sec. 1 Short title.
    - Sec. 2 Table of contents.
    - Sec. 3 References.
    - Sec. 4 Explanatory statement.
    - Sec. 5 Statement of appropriations.
    - Sec. 6 Availability of funds.
    - Sec. 7 Adjustments to compensation.

    - **Division E — Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2024**; Titles I–II.
    - **Division F — Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2024**; Titles I–VII.
    - **Division G — Other Matters**; Titles I–IV: Extensions and Other Matters; Udall Foundation Reauthorization; Funding Limitation for United Nations Relief and Works Agency; Budgetary Effects.
  - No funding amount or legal amendment stated in this section.
